'''Jek Lawquane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]/[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was the son of [[Suu Lawquane/Legends|Suu]], the adopted son of [[Cut Lawquane/Legends|Cut Lawquane]],<ref name="The Deserter Ep Guide" /> and the brother of [[Shaeeah Lawquane/Legends|Shaeeah]]. His shortened [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] were the result of his mixed parentage.<ref name="TCWCE" />

During the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]], the [[Lawquane family/Legends|Lawquanes]] housed the injured [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], who later helped Cut defend [[Lawquane farmstead|the farm]] against the [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]], which Jek and Shaeeah accidentally activated.<ref name="Deserter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jek's first appearance was in the TV series [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'''s]] [[2010]] episode [[The Deserter]], where he was voiced by [[Kath Soucie]], marking her first role in the series. In the subtitles for the episode, Jek's name is misspelled as "Jekk". [[Pablo Hidalgo]] mentioned Jek was always intended to have a human father, although they are not Cut's biological children.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/703719160757383168|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2016-02-27|quote=They're not Cut's children, biologically, but they did have a human father. [...] It wasn't said, but it was part of their character design.|archivefile=File:PabloHidalgo-CutsChildren-Twitter.jpg|nolive=1}}</ref>
